scripts.dev: concurrently "next dev" "cd lexrag/frontend && npm install && npm run dev" "cd lexrag/backend && pip3 install -r requirements.txt && python3 -m uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload"
scripts.build: cd lexrag/frontend && npm install --include=dev && npm run build && mkdir -p ../../public/lexrag-app && cp -r dist/* ../../public/lexrag-app/ && cd ../.. && next build && cp -r public .next/standalone/public && cp -r .next/static .next/standalone/.next/static
